title: ixeridium dentatum subsp. ozense
intro: Ixeridium dentatum subsp. ozense, commonly known as the Japanese wintergreen, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ixeridium dentatum subsp. ozense include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and act as an antibacterial agent. Its bioactive constituents include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
